original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-site-gives-topology}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site with coverings $\text{Cov}(\mathcal{C})$.
For every object $U$ of $\mathcal{C}$, let $J(U)$ denote
the set of sieves $S$ on $U$ with the following property:
there exists a covering
$\{f_i : U_i \to U\}_{i\in I} \in \text{Cov}(\mathcal{C})$
so that the sieve $S'$ generated by the $f_i$ (see Definition
\ref{definition-sieve-generated}) is contained in $S$.
\begin{enumerate}
\item This $J$ is a topology on $\mathcal{C}$.
\item A presheaf $\mathcal{F}$ is a sheaf for this topology
(see Definition \ref{definition-sheaf-sets-topology})
if and only if it is a sheaf on the site (see
Definition \ref{definition-sheaf-sets}).
\end{enumerate}
review_scope: pinned original Stacks lemma and definitions of sieves/topologies; proofs not reviewed
hold_reason: The source separately asserts (1) the site-induced covering sieves define a topology and (2) an iff between the sheaf conditions on the original site and that topology. The proposal makes both iff sides global hypotheses as well as conclusions and retains three raw source Definition refs, distorting the biconditional and standalone context.
proposed_correction: Define the generated sieve explicitly from the family and the two sheaf conditions without raw refs; put only site and J construction as hypotheses, keep topology claim and iff statement as separately quantified conclusions, then independently re-review.
